name: noticed-common-slowdown

finding.title: `beforeNavigate` fetches the preferences again on every page change
finding.description: Before this change `fetchPrefs` ran once and later navigations used `cachedPrefs`. Now every navigation waits for a request to the API before the page renders, so each page change in the app takes one network round trip longer, typically 100 to 300 ms. The preferences are still right.

checks: src/router.ts:11 says the hook runs on every navigation before the page renders

finding.suggestedFix: Keep `cachedPrefs ??= await fetchPrefs();` and refresh the cache only when the preferences change.
